versions.changelog:
- Initial release of generate-moments-copy.
- Supports generating publish-ready Chinese WeChat Moments copy based on user-provided images, themes, and style preferences.
- Ensures copy closely matches the picture, topic, and user’s stylistic requirements while sounding natural and user-authentic.
- Asks targeted questions if any key information (image, theme, style) is missing, without repeating existing info.
- Avoids artificial tone, excessive adjectives, clichés, and obviously AI-generated expressions.
- Outputs concise numbered options with clear differences when quantity is unspecified, and only one when the user requests it.
- Customizes for length, tone, use of emojis, and style as specified by the user, with strict adherence to user’s requests.
